Upgrade jupyter-book to 2.1.7 for the v2 MyST book theme (#524)

* Upgrade jupyter-book to 2.1.7 for the v2 MyST book theme

`template: book-theme` resolves to the newest theme, and since
myst-theme 2.0.0 (2026-11-10) the theme refuses to run under the
static export of jupyter-book 2.1.6, so every HTML build failed.
jupyter-book 2.1.7 builds with the v2 theme, as confirmed upstream in
jupyter-book/myst-theme#1004.

The v2 theme ships its client bundle under `_assets/` instead of
`build/`, so the postbuild back-button workaround now looks there.
Whether the v2 theme still needs that workaround is not verified.

Verified locally from a clean _build: all pages build, the workaround is
appended to the entry bundle, the legacy redirects are written, and every
class selector in custom.css still exists in the v2 markup.
